art_direction: 小丸子短发与童真脸型搭配得体校园衣着，珊瑚赛璐璐头像以小幅招手保持自然儿童神态。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Create Momoko Sakura with her familiar simple bob, short straight bangs, and recognizable round child face. She wears a modest light blouse with a red pinafore and raises one small hand in an everyday greeting. Preserve her natural age and simple facial language while giving both visible eyes enough room for the iris detail. Use clean cel shading, broad coral and cream background shapes, and only a few shadows on the clothing. Her smile is small and cheerful, not a wide caricature. Keep the head and shoulders centered, with no school sign, bag text, or background scene. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for recognizable character, readable requested eye motif, appealing expression, original nonviolent composition, coherent anatomy, no text or watermark
